title: The empty-list state renders with a distinct visual and a creation-affordance recovery control
asA: operator opening a listing surface that has no rows
iWant: the empty-list state to render with a distinct visual and a creation-affordance recovery control
soThat: I know the surface loaded successfully and my next action is to create the first row, not to reload

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given a listing endpoint returning an empty array, the empty-list state renders inside role="region" with a data-visual="empty-list" wrapper (distinct from data-visual="loading" and data-visual="loaded") and a keyboard-reachable [data-recovery="create"] control. The pack drives /probe/empty-list, reads the region and the wrapper attribute, and asserts the recovery control exists and carries an accessible name.
